subject: Mutual action plan: POC environment activation & wiring
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: POC environment activation & wiring

Alex — attaching the finalized mutual action plan for the POC environment so we can lock dates and responsibilities. High level ask: we want to complete API key issuance, org-level admin setup, IP allowlist, and VPC peering in the coming two-week sprint so you can start load testing on week 3.

Top-level milestones (timeline + owner):
- API key provisioning (Redwood to create initial service API key + Healthlytics to rotate / consume) — target: 2028-09-21 — owner: Ben
- Org setup (create healthlytics-redwood service account, RBAC roles for SRE/test users) — target: 2028-09-22 — owner: Healthlytics (Marissa will follow up with role names)
- IP allowlist (Healthlytics to provide public egress IPs; Redwood will add to allowlist) — target: 2028-09-21 — owner: Alex
- VPC peering (exchange CIDR ranges, ASN, and peering window) — target: peering handshakes completed 2028-09-25 — owner: Sergio (Redwood infra) + Healthlytics network

Attached: MAP_Healthlytics_v1.pdf (action table + dates), vpc-peering-template.yaml (manifest we request you fill), api-key-provisioning.md (sample steps).

Next steps: please confirm the IP egress ranges and a preferred 1-hour window on either 9/24 or 9/25 for peering. If we get confirmation, Sergio will submit the peering request and Marissa will open the internal SRE ticket for production-like routing tests.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

— Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@healthlytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Healthlytics Platform Team <platform@healthlytics.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: POC environment activation & wiring

Ben — thanks for the clear plan and the doc. We're aligned on the milestones; a few clarifications from our infra team: 

1) IP allowlist: our egress IPs are 34.11.200.0/24 and 34.11.201.0/24. We can confirm these are static for the POC.
2) VPC peering window: 9/25 10:00–11:00 PT works best for us. We'll need the exact CIDR and ASN you want us to peer to — can you send that?
3) Org roles: we'll create a 'redwood-integration' service account with Owner-like permission restricted to the project 'hl-prod-poc' for the POC phase. We'll confirm the exact IAM bindings by EOD.

Also: curious whether Redwood wants the initial API key to be scoped to a single model (for predictable cost) or unrestricted for the POC. Recommend scoped to the 'redwood-llm-eval' model if possible.

I'll mark the dates in our calendar and upload the filled vpc-peering-template to the Drive link you provided once we have your CIDR/ASN.

— Alex
Alex Chen | Dir. Platform Engineering, Healthlytics
alex.chen@healthlytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 20 Sep 2028 08:17:00 -0700

Ben / Sergio — quick internal coordination: Sergio, I'll need you to confirm the ASN and the peering CIDR we will advertise from Redwood side. For the POC let's use a non-overlapping private /20: 172.31.16.0/20 for the peered subnet and ASN 65551 for Redwood side. Can you validate with infra before I send those values to Alex?

Also I'm opening an SRE ticket right now (internal-#2128) to reserve the peering slot on 9/25 10:00–11:00 PT and to schedule a connectivity smoke test. Ben — when you reply to Alex, please attach the vpc YAML manifest with the CIDR & ASN filled so they can upload it.

Marissa

Alex — confirming the details below and attaching the two small files we mentioned.

Redwood peering info (to plug into your template):
- Redwood advertised CIDR: 172.31.16.0/20
- Redwood ASN: 65551
- Peering window: 2028-09-25 10:00–11:00 PT (Sergio will be on the call)

API key guidance: we'll provision an initial read/write API key scoped to the model named 'redwood-llm-eval' and restrict token quota to the POC budget you confirmed earlier. Healthlytics can create additional keys or rotate at any time. See attached api-key-provisioning.md for instructions and sample curl commands.

Attachments in this message: MAP_Healthlytics_v1.pdf (summary + action checklist), vpc-peering-template.yaml (filled with CIDR/ASN), api-key-provisioning.md. Marissa has opened internal ticket internal-#2128; SRE will run the smoke test post-peering and report results here.

Please upload the signed peering manifest or confirmation to the Drive link and I'll trigger the HubSpot deal stage to 'PEERING SCHEDULED' once I see it. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9876

If the 9/25 slot is confirmed, I'll schedule a Zoom and include Sergio and our SRE on the invite.

Cheers — Ben
